5.2.5.1.2 Application Primitive Data Types - Enumeration
This chapter defines the primitive application data types that may be used for the data prototypes of PortInterfaces or composite application data types. This type of data Application Interfaces User Guide types can be used to describe the states of a state machine or boolean information. Figure 5.21: Example of a Computation Method for an Enumeration DataType Example: In the above screen shot, the Computation Method TrsmPosnGearLvr1 of an Enumeration DataType TrsmPosnGearLvr is defined. All permissible values of the Enumeration DataType are defined, here.
